attrs.evidence: BFMY 1983, both directions. Note this rehabilitates INV-R1's refuted 'nerve' conjecture in corrected form: the refutation used the nerve GRAPH, in which a star of sites is a cyclic K₃; the nerve HYPERGRAPH of a star is α-acyclic. The intuition was right and the carrier was wrong.

local_bindings.scheme: the union hypergraph of the federation

attrs.gap: The two certificates give incomparable sufficient conditions. Cell 36 must state which one a given federation actually provides; it currently describes only the local-satisfiability route.
attrs.statement: If sites certify PAIRWISE CONSISTENCY of their solution projections rather than only local satisfiability, the carrier is α-acyclicity of the SITE hypergraph.
